jump.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Tumble gives +2 on Jump checks. 5+ ranks in Jump gives +2 on Tumble checks.

actions.name: Long Jump
actions.description: Horizontal jump across a gap or obstacle as part of movement (DC = distance in feet).

actions.name: High Jump
actions.description: Vertical jump to reach a ledge (DC = 4 x height in feet).
